sheets.title: An /i/:ref link on a device with no vault — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the link met the front door. After, the approval opens by itself — no unlock, no vault — resolves the link with no session and asks for a sign-in with the Connect note on the route.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1); fragment still in the address; focus on the sign-in field
sheets.after: first render …/i/:ref (fragment gone); .unlock 0; h1 Approve a request, Read the request (warn: Sign in to answer this request.); focus on Connect (44×44, focus-visible)

sheets.title: After Connect: the request to compare — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The approver's view: the match to compare with the other device and the request's facts, approved only with a passkey touch.

sheets.title: Approved with a virtual passkey — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The activation named the digest shown and the verb; the approve named the activation the stand-in verified.
sheets.after: Approved, 1 ok mark, 0 .note; focus on the answer

sheets.title: A link that carried a bearer in its fragment — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The fragment left the address at boot and the link is refused: nothing was resolved or read.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1), #token= still in the address
sheets.after: address …/i/:ref, no fragment; Refused (err: carried credential material); .unlock 0; nothing resolved

sheets.title: An /approve/:ref link: the review — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Who asks, what it would allow, how long it is good for, what it takes and why, and which channel pointed here — ceremony-kit's words.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1), ?utm= still in the address
sheets.after: address …/approve/areq_… (query gone); .unlock 0; focus on the six-digit code (358×44)

sheets.title: Confirmed, code typed, passkey touched — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The activation was minted naming the digest shown and the verb, under the policy shown; the settle named it and the comparison code.
sheets.after: activation {decision: approved, requestDigest}, then approve naming act_1 + code; Approved, 1 ok mark, 0 .note

sheets.title: A deny — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Deny runs its own activation, minted for the deny.
sheets.after: activation {decision: denied} minted for the deny, then deny naming it; Denied

sheets.title: An activation that came back under another policy — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The stand-in mints this one under a policy other than the requirement showed: the review stops before the passkey is asked for, and says the rules changed.
sheets.after: activation came back under another policy: no passkey prompt, no settle; 'This request could not be decided' (err: the rules … changed), 1 err mark

sheets.title: Access › Requests with a hosted row — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The request still waiting is listed beside the local ones; its only key opens /approve/:ref. Nothing on the list approves.
sheets.after: Requests for you · 1 above Local requests; 1 row, 1 link to /approve/, 0 approve buttons; key 44×44
